channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Hart | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Hart from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“I’ll blame it on lacking the leader to show them that ‘hey, this is what you do. Not walk off.’ I blame it on that.“There’s a way to win and there’s a way to lose. And walking off the court, not looking your killer in his eyes, ain’t the way to lose…I hate it. I hate when people do it. And I hated to see those young Spurs do it because I actually think they’re capable of doing something special…and I would urge those young Spurs [to] reach out to Jalen Brunson however you can. Reach out to Karl-Anthony Towns however you can. Reach out to Josh Hart, however you can. You tell [those] dudes ‘congratulations.’”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson, Jun 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: LeBron James on Josh Hart, Alex Caruso
item.description:
LeBron James:

“San Antonio, they're a team that doesn't have ego. They have their personal beliefs on what they can bring to the table. We all do, we're all competitors, but that team is egoless. It's big time to see Josh (Hart) kind of growing to the player that he's in. We always talk about Alex Caruso a lot. It's those certain guys that you can plug into any franchise, any team, and they're going to win because those guys just make winning plays.”

LeBron James on Josh Hart, Alex Caruso, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart
item.description:
Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart's impact:

“He does great things on both sides of the ball. I think his impact, you can't really tell from the stat sheet, but by the eye test, everyone knows that he's a competitor. He brings a winning style of basketball to this team. We need him.”

Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart, Dec 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Josh Hart
item.description:
“I’ll be the first to say that wasn’t the right thing to do [to bench Hart in fourth quarters] because he does so many great things for us and our group and our coaching staff,”

Mike Brown on Josh Hart, Nov 27, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart
item.description:
However, it’s not just seeing his jersey on the backs of others that gets to him, it’s seeing the jerseys of his friends.

“This summer, I was walking down on the boardwalk and I saw a kid wearing a Josh Hart shirt,”

Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart, Nov 4, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Haliburton said before catching himself.

“Everybody is on me to rebound,so just trying to step up there and be the best I could. Everybody’s boxing their guy out, but especially Mitchell Robinson, Josh Hart, they got so many guys that just crash the glass like crazy and I’m just trying to come in and clean it up. And I thought I did a decent job at that.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson, May 29, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Holiday on how they didn't blow a 20pt lead this time:

“We sustained their punches. We tried to keep the energy low in here...not making too many stupid mistakes, and then rebounding the ball...making it difficult on J.Hart getting offensive rebounds, Hart, as well as Robinson.”

Jrue Holiday on Josh Hart, Mitchell Robinson, May 12, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Josh Hart, Miles McBride
item.description:
“A lot of times, I turn, I open up my body to the opposite side and just see. … If the long pass is not there, (I) could get it quick to the guard, and the guard could make something happen: J.B., Deuce (McBride), Josh Hart.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Josh Hart, Miles McBride, Mar 17, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart
item.description:
“And [Hart] is going to hustle and get the loose balls and push the pace and do what he does. If we do that and everyone commits to their strengths and playing defense, we can be good. “But we know right now we are shorthanded, so we have to play real hard and rebound the ball. We have to do that as a team. If we do that, good things will come from it.”

Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart, Nov 10, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart
item.description:
Zach Braziller:Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart:

“From my point of view, I just feel like we need to be better as teammates to make sure we’re all on the same pageor we’re all giving each other confidence regardless. That starts with me.”

Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart, Oct 20, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Josh Hart
item.description:
“But I think we have versatility, where we can play smaller at times because of OG’s ability to guard big. Julius and [Josh] Hart can guard big as well.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Josh Hart, Sep 17, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Josh Hart
item.description:
Mikal Bridges on if he ever thought the Knicks would trade for him as Josh Hart publicly recruited him:

“No, I did not think (so).It's surreal. But it's dope to be a Knick. .. I thought I was gonna be (drafted) here in 2018, and I love everything about the team.”

Mikal Bridges on Josh Hart, Jul 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Josh Hart
item.description:
“I think Josh Hart had a tremendous quote where he talked about people having 12 hour shifts and we get to play a game that we love… That is the nail right on the head for a lot of us.”

Kyrie Irving on Josh Hart, May 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Josh Hart
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“We gotta do much better containing Hart in transition. When he gets a defensive rebound, he’s great at just taking it and knifing his way full court to the basket. He’s a guy we gotta treat like Giannis [Antetokounmpo] and [Damian] Lillard and guys like that that are full court, high speed attackers. He really had a high impact on the game yesterday.”

Rick Carlisle on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Josh Hart, May 8, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Embiid dragging down Mitch play:

“I’m not a journalist but if I were a journalist I’d write a couple things. ...I think the consistency – look at that play and then look at the Josh Hart play in Chicago.”

Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart, Joel Embiid, Apr 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Josh Hart
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Josh Hart:

“I don’t want to be corny, but it many ways, he’s the heart of that team.”

Doc Rivers on Josh Hart, Apr 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart
item.description:
Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart (15 REB):

“No matter what he says or (however much he) complains, one thing he’s gonna do is play hard for 48 minutes. That’s just what he is. That’s in his DNA. He’s been like that since I’ve met him. This is nothing new.”

Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart, Mar 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart
item.description:
Fred Katz:Thibodeau on if Josh Hart was giving him grief about pulling him when he was one short of 20 rebounds:

“He's gonna give me grief about something. It goes in one ear, out the other.”

Tom Thibodeau on Josh Hart, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Josh Hart
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Josh Hart:

“I think what he does at an elite level is he impacts winning. However he does it, he figures out a way to help his team. Some nights, it’s taking charges. Some nights, it’s making shots. He just has a way of impacting the game in a positive way.”

JB Bickerstaff on Josh Hart, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart
item.description:
HoopsHype:Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart (sitting next to him with a Jalen Bruson tshirt):

“Unreal. That's just what he does. I said it after the game. Doesn't matter that it's a playoff game or preseason game or pickup. He plays that way every single time. That's just how he is.”

Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart, Apr 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Josh Hart
item.description:
Larry Nance Jr. on a step he needs to happen to get fully comfortable in Josh Hart's old home (the former teammates swapped places in NOLA/Portland):

“It's getting cozy. He's still got to get all of his crap out. He still has all of his Villanova stuff I can't stand to look at.”

Larry Nance Jr on Josh Hart, Mar 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Larry Nance on Josh Hart
item.description:
Larry Nance on what Josh Hart said about Pels:

“He said he hated leaving here. Obviously, Griff was great to him. He loves Coach Green. All the guys are great. He said nothing but great words about the team & the city…If you embrace the city, fans will embrace you right back.”

Larry Nance on Josh Hart, Feb 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Anthony Davis, Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart
item.description:
“I know it’s part of the business, but it was the first time I felt like somebody didn’t really want me in a way, I guess. But it was Anthony Davis, so there was no shame in that. He’s one of the best players to ever play. “So for myself, BI (Brandon Ingram), and Josh Hart as well, we were happy to get to a new situation and have a start-over moment. I think it helped my career personally. In the long run, it made me a better person and a better player.”

Lonzo Ball on Anthony Davis, Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart, Nov 15, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Willie Green on Josh Hart
item.description:
Christian Clark:Willie Green on Josh Hart:

“Right now it’s day to day. But that could change. If we get an update that he’ll be out longer, we’ll keep you guys aware of it. But right now, it’s more day to day. We’ll see how he feels.”

Willie Green on Josh Hart, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“I can tell you the Wolves have kicked the tires on Paul Millsap, on Josh Hart, on Dennis Schroeder, on Lauri Markkanen,”

Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen, Aug 10, 2021. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Josh Hart
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on bench:

“Josh (Hart) played well today. JJ (Redick) played really well Wednesday. We've had good production out of those two guys. But I haven't given any other guys a CHANCE (to play significant minutes).That's on me. I've got to start using those guys more.”

Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Josh Hart, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Josh Hart
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:A smiling Zion Williamson on Josh Hart:

“I mean, he’s going to throw his body in for the rebound. There are some rebounds where I think I’m going to get it, but I see Josh and I say, ‘Hey, you got it man!’Josh is going to run into his own teammate to get it. He can have it!”

Zion Williamson on Josh Hart, Mar 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on LeBron James, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
“The way (LeBron) is able to make shots and take over a game, it gives you confidence that you have a threat. “Then there’s (Kyle) Kuzma, Josh Hart is a hell of a player, the right kind of player. Lonzo Ball is the kind of player who doesn’t need to score to have a great game. Experience is a key for them and as the season comes on they will get there.”

Dwyane Wade on LeBron James, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball, Dec 11, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Luke Walton on Josh Hart
item.description:
Luke Walton on Josh Hart playing vs. #Nuggets:

“I would expect him to, but we'll see. Marco [Nunez] told me his ankle was hurting this morning, so there's no reason to not let him rest that up and get treatment.”

Luke Walton on Josh Hart, Nov 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.
